Official DHS estimates for Bangladesh

Source: R/official.R
bdhs_official.Rd

A friendly, offline accessor for bdhs_indicators, the official estimates that the DHS Program publishes for every Bangladesh DHS round (the same numbers as STATcompiler and the final reports). Pick indicators by DHS id or by searching their labels and definitions, choose rounds, and get a tidy table back.

Usage

bdhs_official(
  indicator = NULL,
  survey = NULL,
  breakdown = c("national", "subnational", "background", "all"),
  characteristic = NULL,
  preferred = TRUE,
  search = NULL
)

Arguments

indicator

Character vector of DHS indicator ids. NULL (default) keeps every indicator (subject to search).

survey

Survey references understood by bdhs_survey_id(), e.g. 2022, "2017-18" or c(2014, 2022). NULL keeps all rounds.

breakdown

Which rows to return: "national" totals (default), "subnational" (regions and divisions), "background" characteristics (residence, education, wealth, age, ...) or "all". When characteristic is given and breakdown is not, all breakdowns are searched.

characteristic

Characteristic categories to keep, e.g. "Residence", "Wealth quintile", "Education" or "Region" ("Division" is accepted as a synonym). Case-insensitive. The DHS "Region" category holds both the divisions as surveyed and the older groupings kept for trends ("Chattogram/Sylhet", "Dhaka before 2015", "Rajshahi/Rangpur"); tell them apart by characteristic_label, or use bdhs_plot_trend() with by = "Region" (comparable groupings) or by = "Division" (divisions as surveyed).

preferred

If TRUE (default), keep only the headline value of each estimate (the DHS IsPreferred flag). With FALSE, alternative reference periods are returned too and a by_variable_label column says which is which.

search

A regular expression matched (case-insensitively) against indicator ids, labels, short names and definitions in bdhs_indicator_catalog.

Value

A tibble with columns survey_id, year_label, indicator_id, indicator, characteristic_category, characteristic_label, value, ci_low, ci_high, denom_weighted, denom_unweighted, region_id and breakdown (plus by_variable_label when preferred = FALSE), ordered by survey year, indicator and characteristic.

Details

Indicator ids follow the DHS API, e.g. "FE_FRTR_W_TFR" (total fertility rate) or "CN_NUTS_C_HA2" (stunting). Use bdhs_search() to find them.

Subnational rows follow the DHS region hierarchy: the five regions that are comparable across all rounds ("Chattogram/Sylhet", "Dhaka before 2015", "Rajshahi/Rangpur", Barishal, Khulna) and, below them, the divisions of each round (Chattogram, Sylhet, Dhaka, Mymensingh, Rajshahi, Rangpur). The region_id column links to bdhs_boundaries() (reg_id).

See also

bdhs_search() to find indicators, bdhs_plot_trend() and bdhs_map() to visualise them.

Examples

# Total fertility rate in every round
bdhs_official("FE_FRTR_W_TFR")
#> # A tibble: 9 × 13
#>   survey_id year_label indicator_id  indicator            characteristic_categ…¹
#>   <chr>     <chr>      <chr>         <chr>                <chr>                 
#> 1 BD1994DHS 1993-94    FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 2 BD1997DHS 1996-97    FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 3 BD2000DHS 1999-2000  FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 4 BD2004DHS 2004       FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 5 BD2007DHS 2007       FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 6 BD2011DHS 2011       FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 7 BD2014DHS 2014       FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 8 BD2017DHS 2017-18    FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> 9 BD2022DHS 2022       FE_FRTR_W_TFR Total fertility rat… Total                 
#> # ℹ abbreviated name: ¹​characteristic_category
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: characteristic_label <chr>, value <dbl>, ci_low <dbl>,
#> #   ci_high <dbl>, denom_weighted <dbl>, denom_unweighted <dbl>,
#> #   region_id <chr>, breakdown <chr>

# Stunting by wealth quintile in the two latest rounds
bdhs_official("CN_NUTS_C_HA2", survey = c("2017-18", 2022), characteristic = "Wealth quintile")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 13
#>    survey_id year_label indicator_id  indicator        characteristic_category
#>    <chr>     <chr>      <chr>         <chr>            <chr>                  
#>  1 BD2017DHS 2017-18    CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  2 BD2017DHS 2017-18    CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  3 BD2017DHS 2017-18    CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  4 BD2017DHS 2017-18    CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  5 BD2017DHS 2017-18    CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  6 BD2022DHS 2022       CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  7 BD2022DHS 2022       CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  8 BD2022DHS 2022       CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#>  9 BD2022DHS 2022       CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#> 10 BD2022DHS 2022       CN_NUTS_C_HA2 Children stunted Wealth quintile        
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: characteristic_label <chr>, value <dbl>, ci_low <dbl>,
#> #   ci_high <dbl>, denom_weighted <dbl>, denom_unweighted <dbl>,
#> #   region_id <chr>, breakdown <chr>

# Anything about anemia, by division, in 2011
bdhs_official(search = "anemia", survey = 2011, breakdown = "subnational")
#> # A tibble: 90 × 13
#>    survey_id year_label indicator_id  indicator           characteristic_categ…¹
#>    <chr>     <chr>      <chr>         <chr>               <chr>                 
#>  1 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#>  2 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#>  3 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#>  4 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region

#>  7 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#>  8 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#>  9 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_ANY Children with any … Region                
#> 10 BD2011DHS 2011       CN_ANMC_C_MLD Children with mild… Region                
#> # ℹ 80 more rows
#> # ℹ abbreviated name: ¹​characteristic_category
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: characteristic_label <chr>, value <dbl>, ci_low <dbl>,

#> #   region_id <chr>, breakdown <chr>
